verdict.rationale: EBANX documents chargeback management, saying merchants can "manage, respond to, and track chargeback cases" (ebanx-docs-7). It also publishes an llms.txt with LLM-agent instructions (ebanx-probe-1, ebanx-docs-28), but nothing confirms that disputes can be retrieved, given evidence, and answered through the API rather than the dashboard. The OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404 (ebanx-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented dispute retrieval endpoints, evidence upload/assembly API, programmatic dispute response submission, dispute webhooks, machine-readable API spec, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven dispute handling.
